mods.name: SeamlessInteriors
mods.author: Hamsi Buglama
mods.description: A massive overhaul mod developed for The Long Dark that aims to integrate all interior buildings directly into the open world without any loading screens. Walk through doors seamlessly and experience the interior and exterior as one unified environment.

status.notes:
This mod is very early in development. Even after testing, it may contain bugs that haven't been discovered yet. You can use it with your primary/master save files, but be sure to back up your files. Please consider the risks before installing.

There is a high risk of conflicts with other mods that modify the structure or interior of buildings. It has not yet been tested with other custom interior mods.

mods.name: Terrain Editor
mods.author: Hamsi Buglama
mods.description: A mod that allows you to customize the world's terrain, structures, and objects.
